findings.type: third-party implementation and tool-list scanner integration
findings.observation: The first commit adds source, CLI, and 92 vendored fixtures. The following commit computes the digest after reading a complete paginated list and carries it in the observation record. Canari reports 92 matching fixtures and no mismatches versus reference Python on 300 generated tool lists.
findings.verified_scope: Read GitHub's public commit metadata and changed files. The repository version was bumped to 0.1.7; PyPI still returned 0.1.6. Counts are the maintainer's results. The downloaded fixture is byte-identical to the upstream file at check time.

findings.operator: astrogilda, contributor in the OWASP discussion
findings.observation: Cites a HISTOR dataset example where four descriptions changed and the fifth stayed equal, to illustrate how to compare descriptors when both producers used the same digest profile.
findings.verified_scope: New comment in the previously observed issue. The issue remains open.

findings.type: human offer to coordinate test vectors
findings.observation: In a reply about TRAIL on Agentproto, the OCX author says a tool-set digest independently verifiable against a public log could identify the tool definition behind a receipt, and offers to align test vectors.
findings.verified_scope: Older message newly found in this review. Current published OCX draft is an individual -00 and has no exact link to the digest.

findings.type: first-hand technical article from another implementation
findings.observation: Both released SDKs compute contract and extras digests, and the lockfile carries both. Author reports 0 differences over 3,000 generated in-range tool lists in a Python/JavaScript comparison.
findings.verified_scope: The article URL was in the 23 November raw query index. This pass verified the article and its exact claims. The prior implementation and contribution were already known.

findings.observation: A public, ModelMarket-specific demo compares three surfaces: the MCP server card, ARD catalog digest, and AID endpoint proof.
findings.verified_scope: Direct public page returned HTTP 200 and named the operator in its page metadata. Demo publication date and independent use counts are unverified. IETF correspondence was already known.

findings.observation: The platform's house tester reports 3 listed tools in 2 seconds via uvx without credentials on 0.10.0. mcpcost still shows needs_args for its 18 November run of 0.10.0, while MCP Registry shows 0.11.0 with optional URL default.
findings.verified_scope: One house report, no secondary confirmation. Measurements refer to the recorded versions and probe conditions.

findings.observation: ARGUS 0.6.2 reported 3 tools at 26.5 s and was labeled slow. WARDEN 0.36.0 reported 9 tools at 1.6 s in the same report.
findings.verified_scope: The platform started packages via npx in an empty folder without credentials, then called initialize and tools/list. These are full startup-path times for one run.

findings.operator: MCP Checkup / Clear Data Decisions LLC

findings.verified_scope: The report was already in the 21 November evidence. The run shown here is newer and is 24 November in Amsterdam.
